notes: Each tooltip is a `popover="hint"` opened by `interestfor` on its button. The browser shows it on hover, keyboard focus or long-press, waits a short delay before showing and hiding, keeps it open while the pointer is over it, and hides it on Escape, which a `::after` tooltip could never do. The text is also linked with `aria-describedby`, so screen readers read it with the button.

Anchor positioning places each hint on its side of the button with `position-area` (top, right, bottom, left), and `position-try-fallbacks` flips it when it would overflow the viewport. As a `popover` it lives in the top layer, so no ancestor overflow or z-index can clip it.

Browsers without interest invokers fall back to CSS: the same element is shown on `:hover` and `:focus-visible` of its button and still anchored, so it works with mouse and keyboard, but it cannot be dismissed with Escape.
